blocks.title: Collaboration
blocks.text: Collaboration do ya zyada logon ka mushtarak maqsad ke liye mil kar kaam karna hai, khayalat, wasail aur mehnat share kar ke.

Students group projects par aur community ke log taqreebat ke liye mil kar kaam karte hain. Science exhibition ke model mein ek student khaake banata, doosra model, aur teesra samjhata hai, aur nateeja kisi akele se behtar project hota hai (class activity).

blocks.prompt: Entrepreneurial amal mein tawun kyun ahem hai (short question 8)?
blocks.explanation: Kisi bani mein har maharat nahi hoti; shurakaa, mulazim aur mushir mukhtalif khoobiyan, khayalat aur wasail late hain, to masail jaldi hal hote aur karobar mazboot hota hai.

items: Tawun mukhtalif khoobiyan mila kar behtar nateeja deta hai.
